Four merged since your last message. Here's where #34 stands.

**[#48](https://github.com/missingbulb/hitbut/pull/48) — phase 4, ingestion** (`74d3f50`). The chain merge→embed→assign→place as one module the cron and the backfill Workflow both run. Two properties: every stage keyed on what the payload determines, so a replay writes nothing new *and pays neither model twice* — that second half is what makes a decades-long backfill affordable; and each stage commits before the next, so a rate-limited stance call doesn't cost the utterance beside it. Both seen failing first.

Until #27 provisions Vectorize and the models, the production ports **fail by name** rather than no-opping — a no-op would let every pass report success while the corpus silently gained no subjects, with nothing anywhere saying why.

**[#50](https://github.com/missingbulb/hitbut/pull/50) — phase 6, detection** (`6fc4b19`). Anomalies and change points as pure functions over a series.

Two things the cases found that I hadn't set out to fix:

- **Every point of a bimodal series read as an anomaly** — and a bimodal series is exactly what a trend change looks like, so one series came back claimed twice in two incompatible ways. An anomaly now has to be *alone*: a candidate a fraction of the series keeps company with is a second position the persona holds, not an utterance out of step.
- **The fixture was inventing dates.** `withUtterance` used `?? default`, so a case saying "the source establishes no date" got one anyway — the exact failure `1.3` and `1.9` exist to prevent, sitting in the fixtures where it would have propped up any case about undated utterances.

The third leaf is the silence — flat, too-short, and drifting-without-stepping all come back empty. A detector that finds something in every series finds nothing.

Also in these: a source module now declares the room it reports from (venue is a property of the speech act, not of how the document was published), and venue/audience/date-precision went from three copies to one array with the type derived, plus a gate holding the migrations' `CHECK` constraints to it — verified by adding a venue to the type alone and watching it fire.

One thing I'm holding despite the blanket approval: **I won't put a real person in the roster.** That's [#28](https://github.com/missingbulb/hitbut/issues/28)'s call and a real-world exposure, not a code change. Everything committed stays invented until you've had the legal review.

Running totals: 66 default-lane, 12 server on real workerd, 11 screen goldens, 0 blocking. Still nothing verified by CI.

> ⚠️ Still open: [#39](https://github.com/missingbulb/hitbut/issues/39) Actions outage — six merges now unverified, yours to unblock (billing/minutes) · [#28](https://github.com/missingbulb/hitbut/issues/28) legal review · [#27](https://github.com/missingbulb/hitbut/issues/27) Cloudflare provisioning, which phase 5 needs · [#32](https://github.com/missingbulb/hitbut/issues/32) source recon green light · [#34](https://github.com/missingbulb/hitbut/issues/34) phase 5 blocked on #27; phase 7 (backfill Workflow) blocked on phase 1, which needs Cloudflare docs the sandbox can't reach. Next I'll take phase 8 — moving the API and site onto utterances and findings — since it's the last phase that needs nothing from you.
Phase 8 is the *migrate* step of #37 — readers move to utterances and findings while the old shape stays written. Reading what has to move:

-- The search index over utterances, so the site can search what it now shows.
--
-- A second index rather than a repointed one: `statements_fts` is still written and still
-- correct for the shape it indexes, and this is the expand step's other half — the reader
-- moves, the old index goes with the old table in the contract step.
--
-- The indexed text is the *folded* form, not the quote: Hebrew glues prefixes onto words
-- and FTS5 knows nothing about that, so folding happens on the way in and on the way out
-- and the two must agree. The utterance keeps the fullest wording any attestation carries,
-- which is what makes indexing it rather than each attestation the right call — otherwise
-- one speech carried by five outlets is five hits for one sentence.
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE utterances_fts USING fts5 (
  utterance_id UNINDEXED,
  search_text
);

A page that buried it would be showing a quote and calling it an inconsistency, and `6.11` asserts the venue and the audience are on the page and that it does not borrow the pair shape. ## Dates say what the source established April 2025 renders as **אפריל 2025**, not as a day in it. Rendering a month as a day invents a fact, and it is the kind nobody catches, because a specific date always looks more authoritative than a vague one. `1.9` has been in the spec since #40; this is the first time a reader sees it. ## The export One line per **utterance**, with every document that reported it on the same line. A line per attestation would put one speech in the file three times and let a count of the export read the echo as three things said — the failure the utterance split exists to prevent, arriving through the export instead of the timeline. ## Two things found while doing it **A Hebrew prefix was rendering detached.** JSX inserts a space between an expression and the element after it, so `{strings.addressedTo} ` gave «נאמר ב עצרת».
